title: Property Detail Page + SEO
goal: Build property detail page with image gallery, specs, contact CTA, and full SEO setup.
result_summary: Created /properties/[id] dynamic page with: image gallery grid, intent/category badges, price display (INR format), specs grid (BHK, bath, area, listed date), features/amenities tags, sticky contact sidebar with ContactForm. Added sitemap.ts for SEO. OpenGraph metadata in layout. Full dark theme with Framer Motion animations.
